basic_profile.bio: I'm a gaming enthusiast from Portland, Oregon, diving into the world of Royale High trading. I work as a part-time barista and am currently studying architecture, which explains my interest in the 'Architects' subreddit. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 6 PM to 10 PM PST. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time playing online games, exploring new subreddits, and occasionally dabbling in digital art.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a moderate understanding of Royale High trading, acquired through watching tutorial videos and participating in Reddit discussions. My interest in games extends to Skylords Reborn and Walking War Robots, where I've learned through trial and error and community interaction.
